summary: Gerdau S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2Q26 quarterly results. The report covers operational and financial metrics, including steel shipments, net sales, adjusted EBITDA, and net income, plus dividends and share buyback progress. It also mentions progress on the acquisition of Dona Francisca Energética (DFESA) to increase self-generated energy. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation event such as a tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review. The mention of an acquisition is a general update, not a definitive special-situation filing.
